title: MILO Marathon 2026 Cebu Leg Review: One of the Series' Biggest Regional Fields
seo_title: MILO Marathon Cebu Leg 2026 Review | Philippines
meta_description: MILO Marathon 2026 Cebu Leg review: September 6 -- historically one of the largest legs in the series, with a record 24,000+ runners in 2019.
dek: Set for 6 September 2026 somewhere in Metro Cebu, this leg has drawn some of the biggest fields in the entire MILO Marathon series -- over 24,000 runners in 2019 -- though the exact host city within Cebu has changed nearly every year recently.
verdict: The Cebu leg is one of the heavyweight stops on the MILO Marathon calendar: a record field of over 24,000 runners in 2019 and still over 16,000 in 2024, backed by Cebuano Olympian and six-time series champion Mary Joy Tabal's involvement in local organising. Early gun starts (4:30am for the 21K) manage the heat, and past organisers have reported clean, well-run editions. The genuine wrinkle is venue instability -- the host location within Metro Cebu has shifted almost every year recently, from Cebu City Sports Center to Mandaue to Lapu-Lapu -- so specific 2026 logistics need confirming closer to race day.

sections.heading: One of the Series' Biggest Regional Legs
paragraphs: The Cebu leg has historically been one of the largest regional legs in the entire MILO Marathon series, with a record field of over 24,000 runners in 2019 and over 16,000 in 2024. [1] Categories in recent Cebu-area editions have included 21K, 10K, 5K and 3K, with the 5K typically drawing the largest number of entrants -- a genuinely mass-participation event by Philippine standards.

sections.heading: Early Starts to Beat the Heat
paragraphs: Recent editions used early gun starts to manage conditions: the 21K starts at 4:30am with a 2h30m cutoff, the 10K at 5:00am with a 1h30m cutoff, and the 5K/3K/1K starting between 5:30-5:45am. [1] Cebu leg organiser Ricky Ballesteros, reflecting on a past edition, said: "Everything went on smoothly. No untoward incident. The weather cooperated although it was a little bit hot, but thank God it didn't rain." [2] An elite runner quoted in the same report added: "I love it here. I like Cebu. It was a well-organized race." [2]

sections.heading: Mary Joy Tabal's Local Involvement
paragraphs: Local organising has often involved Cebuano Olympian and six-time MILO Marathon champion Mary Joy Tabal, who has helped run the leg with RUNRIO and local city governments. [1] That local elite-athlete connection gives the Cebu leg a degree of homegrown credibility beyond its scale alone.

sections.heading: The Host Venue Keeps Moving
paragraphs: The exact host venue within Metro Cebu has shifted in recent years -- Cebu City Sports Center (2019 and earlier), Mandaue City (2024), and Lapu-Lapu City (2025) -- so participants should confirm the specific start/finish location for the 2026 edition well in advance. [1] Packet pick-up and start-line logistics are consequently not consistent year to year, which is worth planning around if you're travelling from outside Cebu.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want to be part of one of the MILO Marathon series' largest and most established regional legs, with genuine local elite-athlete involvement, the Cebu leg on 6 September 2026 delivers scale and history. Just confirm the exact 2026 host venue directly with organisers before finalising travel, since it's changed almost every year recently.
